glossary.definition:
(F) As used in division (A)(3)(b) of this section, "benefits" means payments by a self-insuring employer to, or on behalf of, an employee for any of the following: a hospital bill; a medical bill to a licensed physician, certified nurse-midwife, clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse practitioner, or hospital; or an orthopedic or prosthetic device.
